latin: Prouidentia est statuitiue in deo, ordinatiue in intelligentia, exequtiue in anima, denuntiatiue in coelo, terminatiue in toto uniuerso.
translation: Providence exists in God in a decreeing manner, in intelligence in an ordering manner, in the soul in an executing manner, in the heaven in a declaring manner, and in the whole universe in a terminating manner.
